en: Changed Claude in Chrome in auto mode to skip the extension's per-site check for classifier-approved calls, as bypass mode does, fixing `browser_batch` "Permission denied" after a redirect
zh: 变更自动模式下的 Claude in Chrome 对分类器批准的调用跳过扩展的逐站点检查，与 bypass 模式一致，修复重定向后 `browser_batch` 出现“Permission denied”的问题
